meta.description: From 0 at the base to 1 at the tip: where a branch or instance sits on its parent path, and along the path for thickness and color. Across goes from 0 on the middle of a geometry to 1 at its edge, set_color reads it at every vertex, everywhere else it is 0.

direction.description: Along goes from the base to the tip, across from the middle of a geometry to its edge, like from the midrib of a leaf to its margin.
